updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Permissions Audit Log Improvements
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview is enhancing audit logs to provide clearer visibility into role and scoped-role access decisions when users access the portal. Administrators will gain better troubleshooting capabilities and improved monitoring of authorization outcomes across the compliance environment.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention Extended to Non-Microsoft Connected Apps
updates.summary: Purview Data Loss Prevention and Information Protection auto-labeling now protect non-Microsoft cloud applications including Google Workspace, Box, Dropbox, Salesforce, ServiceNow, AWS, and Cisco Webex. Admins can apply consistent DLP policies and sensitivity labeling across a broader ecosystem of third-party platforms.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Network Data Security Integration with Palo Alto Prisma Access
updates.summary: Purview network data security now integrates with Palo Alto Prisma Access to discover and protect sensitive data shared with unmanaged cloud apps over HTTP/HTTPS traffic. This enriches Purview's Data Security Posture Management by using existing classifiers, sensitive information types, and sensitivity labels across network monitoring.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Unified Classification Management Experience
updates.summary: Purview is consolidating all classifiers—Sensitive Information Types, Exact Data Match, fingerprint SITs, and trainable classifiers—into a single unified interface for discovery, creation, validation, and management. This centralized approach reduces complexity and improves governance over classification policies.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection Scanner Data Export for Custom Reporting
updates.summary: The information protection scanner now exports labeling, classification, and protection action data to SQL tables, enabling administrators to build custom reports and gain deeper insights into the state of scanned repositories. This data foundation supports compliance auditing and regulatory reporting needs.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Retention for Copilot Memory
updates.summary: Administrators can now configure retention policies for Microsoft 365 Copilot memory stored in hidden Exchange mailbox folders, enabling preservation of historical memory versions for security and compliance investigations. This capability helps maintain visibility into memory changes while active memory remains user-managed.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Legacy Teams Retention Policies to Be Scoped Teams-Only
updates.summary: Existing retention policies scoped to Microsoft Teams that currently implicitly apply to Copilot interactions will be converted to Teams-only policies, ending their coverage of Copilot workloads. Administrators should review and update policies to explicitly govern Copilot retention if needed.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention Now Monitors FTP and SFTP Transfers
updates.summary: Endpoint DLP is now generally available for monitoring sensitive data transfers over FTP and SFTP protocols, allowing administrators to apply restrictive actions based on organizational policy. This closes a gap in data protection for file transfer methods commonly used in enterprise environments.

updates.title: Chromium: 11 Authorization Vulnerabilities Patched in Microsoft Edge
updates.summary: Microsoft Edge has addressed 11 Chromium-based authorization vulnerabilities spanning multiple components including Chromoting, BrowserTag, Downloads, WebProtect, USB, Select, SiteIsolation, Extensions, Core, and BFCache. Administrators should ensure Edge is updated to the latest version to mitigate potential privilege escalation and cross-origin access risks.
